name: Tegula - Digital Art Clock
author: Stefan Keller
description: Wear your love of art on your wrist. Tegula shows the time over a color composition in the spirit of the Swiss Concrete artist Richard Paul Lohse. Each start of the clock brings a new one, out of more than 20 million. Swipes show date, seconds, a new composition or widgets; double tap bottom left for a flashlight.
